points.description: Steepest descent is used to update the weights/parameters of the network during learning (training), in order to minimise the cost/error function.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it is used in learning/optimisation without mentioning weight updates or minimising cost.

points.description: Weights are moved in the direction opposite to the gradient (downhill, direction of steepest decrease of the cost).
points.partial_credit: Half if mentions using the gradient or slope but direction is vague.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying steepest descent updates the weights to reduce the cost function and that it moves against the gradient, in any wording. Give half marks for vague answers, e.g. "it helps the network find the best weights" without the gradient idea. Mention of local minima or instability is optional and not needed for full marks.
